result.summary: The page is mostly well-composed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel row has vertically misaligned cards: image tiles and their titles/delivery lines sit at different heights across the row, making the layout look broken. Other elements (header, search, promo banner, popular list, bottom nav) appear consistent.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal row, the restaurant cards are vertically misaligned: the Green Bowl Poké image tile starts higher than the Smash Bros Burgers tile, which in turn starts higher than the Trattoria Piccola tile, so their titles and delivery-fee lines sit at three different baselines and the row looks jagged/broken.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to a common top edge (e.g. align-items: flex-start on the row container) and give image tiles a fixed aspect ratio/height so titles and metadata lines line up across cards.

issues.description: The delivery-time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') are pinned to inconsistent positions on their image tiles (bottom-left on the first card, lower-left overlapping differently on the others), reinforcing the misaligned appearance of the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent badge anchor (same offset from the tile's bottom-left corner) on every card so badges align uniformly across the row.
